I replied to Tobias in the #central-random thread: the ticket is **PD-4821**. It's the ticket with the Marrow Agrisupply Eastbank receiving-door import attached.

The source is Hollis's message in #central-team on Jun 9, 2026, and Tobias is a member of that channel. At that point the door labels in the import file (E1/E2) didn't match their booking sheet (01/02), and that needed fixing before anyone reimported. I couldn't see any ticket files for Marrow Agrisupply in the shared files, so I don't know the ticket's current status.
